scenarios.name: Snapshot stores original content for restoration
scenarios.evidence: Snapshot type (project.ts:32-40) has textContent but no content field. createSnapshot (projectFileService.ts:96-131) receives TipTap JSON but only extracts plain text via extractText(). Original content is NOT stored in snapshot file.
scenarios.impact: Faithful restoration of rich text (bold, italic, links) impossible — only plain text recoverable

scenarios.name: restoreSnapshot writes correct content
scenarios.evidence: restoreSnapshot (projectFileService.ts:159-168) reads raw snapshot file JSON string via readTextFile and writes it as chapter content. This writes the snapshot wrapper {id,chapterId,timestamp,contentHash,textContent,fileSize} as the chapter's TipTap content, corrupting the chapter.
scenarios.impact: Restoring any snapshot corrupts the chapter — editor shows raw JSON instead of formatted content

scenarios.name: Create project → add volume → add chapter → write content → read back
scenarios.evidence: createNewProject in projectSlice creates project+volume+chapter atomically. writeChapterContent + readChapterContent round-trip verified in projectFileService

scenarios.name: Migration: localStorage drafts → filesystem project
scenarios.evidence: migrateFromLocalStorage handles: empty drafts (early return), backup → create project structure → write TipTap JSON → validate → update store → set flag

scenarios.name: Snapshot creation → diff → restore cycle
scenarios.evidence: createSnapshot writes snapshot file. diffSnapshots correctly uses textContent for line diff. But restoreSnapshot writes snapshot wrapper JSON instead of original content — restores corrupts the chapter. HistoryPanel triggers window.location.reload() after restore (line 153), making corruption immediately visible.

failures.rule: Snapshot must store original TipTap JSON content for faithful restoration
failures.actual: Snapshot type has no content field. createSnapshot discards original content, keeps only textContent (plain text extracted from TipTap)
failures.fix: Add content: string field to Snapshot interface. Store raw content parameter in createSnapshot.

failures.rule: restoreSnapshot must write the original chapter content, not the snapshot wrapper
failures.actual: restoreSnapshot reads raw snapshot JSON file and writes it as chapter content, corrupting the chapter
failures.fix: Extract content field from parsed snapshot object and write that as chapter content.

failures.rule: End-to-end snapshot restore must leave chapter in valid state
failures.actual: Restore cycle corrupts chapter content with snapshot wrapper JSON. HistoryPanel reloads page after restore, showing corrupted content.
failures.fix: Fix BT-001 + BT-002. Also consider replacing window.location.reload() with store update + content refresh.

note: BT-001, BT-002, BT-003 are the same root cause reported at different granularity. Fix requires: (1) add content field to Snapshot type, (2) store content in createSnapshot, (3) fix restoreSnapshot to extract content from parsed snapshot.
